creativeThesis: Follow natural rock until its nuclear behavior becomes understandable.
viewerExperience: An impossible-seeming reactor becomes a place, present evidence, ancient fuel and a physical chain sustained by water; qualified feedback adds surprise without displacing the central payoff.
emotionalTarget: Deep-time astonishment resolving into grounded physical understanding.
visualThesis: Enter layered mineral relief; change physical scale for the neutron mechanism and return to the ore body. No cooling towers, clocks or faux archival measurements.

decisions.treatment: Original procedural geological relief across the frame, with slow spatial camera moves and selective full-field microscopic cutaways.
decisions.rationale: Rock is the protagonist; the mechanism can be shown without fake historical footage or a fixed diagram lecture.
alternativesConsidered: Photographic geological documentary with short scientific overlays.
A single flat cutaway schematic throughout.

decisions.treatment: Warm layered mineral surfaces, charcoal ore seams, cool water pathways and restrained amber heat illumination. Sparse large type appears only at story anchors.
decisions.rationale: Material scale and contrast follow rock, water and heat; glowing ore is an explicit heat illustration, not visible radioactivity.

decisions.treatment: Kokoro af_heart at 0.97, complete semantic sentences, natural curiosity and clear isotope names.
decisions.rationale: Established primary voice; factual qualifiers are spoken, not relegated to a footnote.

decisions.treatment: Manrope48/600 pale ivory on a calm lower gradient, authored natural speech phrases with fixed glyphs.
decisions.rationale: Readable words remain stable while camera scale changes; captions carry exact reviewed meaning.

decisions.treatment: Voice and silence, without music or fabricated radiation sounds.
decisions.rationale: The extraordinary mechanism needs comprehension rather than menace or pseudo-authentic recording.

decisions.treatment: Measured sentence audio sets duration; short evidence and causal-transition holds.
decisions.rationale: Fuel, neutron economy and moderation each need time; no target duration threshold or padding.

decisions.treatment: Immediate geological heat seam under the statement that Earth had reactors before humans; concise two-billion-year anchor.
decisions.rationale: Shows natural rock rather than a modern cooling tower, protecting the contradiction from a false engineered-plant implication.

decisions.treatment: 1080×1920 at30fps; critical text inset and calm speech field. Four provisional sampled profile preflights as master QA only.
decisions.rationale: No platform variants or release preparation; native UI and real-device behavior remain unknown.

convenienceResponse.chosenForStory: The approved payoff is conditions arising in rock. Geological presence, evidence and changing scale carry that realization; no forced style rotation or domain palette.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Four most recent owner-approved exact masters by actual decision-entry time; no scheduling/publication/analytics inference.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: Natural rock and groundwater are visually dominant; brief atomic explanation supports a geological journey.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Fixed schematic convenience compared with documentary material and continuous procedural relief; choose actual story value, not cosmetic novelty.

ownerReview.rationale: Routine original production using existing local capabilities, internally verified claims and established licenses. Next normal owner gate is Master Review.

risks: Illustrative rock relief is not actual Oklo geology or footage.
